verses.text: In my troubles I pled with God to help me and he did!
Deliver me, O Lord, from liars.
O lying tongue, what shall be your fate?
You shall be pierced with sharp arrows and burned with glowing coals.

footnotes.text: with glowing coals, literally, “with coals of the broom tree.”

verses.text: My troubles pile high among these haters of the Lord, these men of Meshech and Kedar. I am tired of being here among these men who hate peace.
I am for peace, but they are for war, and my voice goes unheeded in their councils.
